title: High latency on API endpoints
description: API responses are lagging. Could be high network congestion or the database taking too long to write to the transaction log.
resolution: Identified broadcast storm on the subnet and implemented VLAN segmentation.

title: Switch port request
description: I need two ports opened on the switch for the new VoIP phones we just received. The rack is in the basement. Let me know when you can handle this.
resolution: Configured ports 12 and 13 on Switch-Base-01 for Voice VLAN 50; enabled LLDP-MED for phone auto-discovery.

title: Locked out of SAP
description: Hey, I tried logging into SAP this morning and got locked out after three failed attempts. Could you please reset my access? I'm currently working on the Q3 financial reports and need this resolved ASAP.
resolution: Verified user identity and unlocked the SAP user account via transaction SU01.

title: Outlook search not returning recent emails
description: Outlook for Windows is not indexing emails sent after yesterday. I've tried rebuilding the index, but it says 'Indexing complete' with 0 items. Help.
resolution: Repaired the Office 365 installation and forced a re-index of the OST file via the Indexing Options control panel.

title: Static IP mapping requested
description: I need a static IP for the new Linux production server. The hostname is PROD-SRV-04 and it needs to reside in the 10.10.50.0/24 subnet.
resolution: Assigned static IP 10.10.50.45 and updated the DNS record and DHCP exclusion range accordingly.

title: Slow read/write speeds on shared network drive
description: Users are complaining that the Z: drive is sluggish. It takes forever to open small Excel files. We are running Windows Server 2019, and the latency spikes seem to correlate with the scheduled daily incremental backup task.
resolution: Adjusted the QoS policy on the network switch and rescheduled the backup window to off-peak hours to reduce I/O contention.

title: NAS Volume Inaccessible
description: Our departmental NAS (QNAP TS-873A) is showing a 'Volume Degraded' status. Users report they cannot map the network drive to their Windows 10 workstations. I've tried restarting the service, but it didn't help.
resolution: Replaced faulty WD Red Pro 8TB drive in bay 4 and initiated RAID 6 rebuild.

title: Need VPN access
description: Working from home today and the Cisco AnyConnect client is throwing an error: 'Security Gateway Unreachable'. My home ISP is fine, but I suspect the firewall at the office is blocking my home IP range.
resolution: Updated the VPN gateway firewall rules to whitelist the user's updated residential IP range.

title: Phishing email reported
description: Just wanted to flag a message that hit my inbox this morning. It claims to be from IT and asks me to 'validate my mailbox' via an external link. I didn't click it, but thought you should know.
resolution: Confirmed email as malicious phishing attempt; added sender domain to the O365 blocklist and purged the email from all user mailboxes.

title: Slow I/O performance on SQL Cluster
description: We are seeing significant performance degradation on our SQL Cluster nodes. Disk latency on the LUNs hosting the data files is spiking above 50ms during peak batch jobs. This is causing application timeouts.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured multi-pathing policy on the host side; updated HBA settings to use round-robin path selection to balance I/O across controllers.

title: Unauthorized Device Alert
description: Hey, the NAC just blocked a device on port 24 (MAC: 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E) because it's trying to hit the prod network. Could you take a look?
resolution: Investigated the device and confirmed it was a personal laptop; moved the port to the restricted VLAN.

title: VPN access keeps dropping
description: Hey, my VPN keeps dropping every 15 minutes today and it's super disruptive. I'm on Windows 11 using Cisco AnyConnect—any chance someone could take a look? Thanks!
resolution: Identified conflicting MTU settings on the user's home ISP router; adjusted client-side VPN adapter settings to accommodate packet fragmentation.

title: Absolute disaster - server room AC off
description: The CRAC unit is down and the temperature in the server room is hitting 95 degrees Fahrenheit! We are going to start losing hardware if this isn't fixed immediately. Please send someone right now!
resolution: Escalated to HVAC vendor; failed control board replaced. Temperature returned to standard 68 degrees within 45 minutes.

title: Firewall Rule Request
description: I need port 443 opened from our internal subnet 192.168.10.0/24 to the external vendor API at 203.0.113.45 immediately. We have a software deployment this Friday and this should have been handled already. Stop stalling and get this done before it causes us a major delay.
resolution: Applied new firewall policy rule ID 405 on the Palo Alto firewall and verified connectivity.

title: Minor typo in email signature
description: THE ENTIRE OFFICE IS AT A STANDSTILL! THERE IS A MISSING COMMA IN THE AUTOMATED SIGNATURE TEMPLATE AND WE ARE LOSING CLIENT TRUST BY THE SECOND. FIX THIS IMMEDIATELY OR EVERYTHING WILL FALL APART!
resolution: Corrected the punctuation in the email signature template.

title: Drive failure on RAID 5 array
description: Hey, one of the drives in our primary storage array (Slot 4) is showing a predictive failure warning. The PERC H740P controller log indicates 'Foreign configuration detected' and multiple 'Media Error' entries. Need a replacement ASAP before we lose parity.
resolution: Ordered and replaced the failed SAS drive; triggered a RAID rebuild which completed successfully without data loss.

title: Unable to access portal
description: I can't get to the HR portal. It says 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'. I am on Windows 11. Help.
resolution: Flushed the local DNS cache and corrected the static DNS server entries on the user's network adapter.

title: Warehouse Wi-Fi dead zones
description: The scanners in the back of the warehouse are constantly dropping off the network. I think we need more access points back there because it's impossible to track inventory right now.
resolution: Performed an RF site survey and adjusted the transmit power on AP-WH-04 and AP-WH-05 to reduce channel overlap.

title: Cannot access VPN - GlobalProtect
description: I'm trying to connect to the corporate VPN using GlobalProtect 6.0.4 on my MacBook Pro running macOS Sonoma, but I keep getting 'Authentication Failed: Invalid Credentials' even though my password works for Outlook. I've restarted my machine twice and cleared the cache, but the error persists. Please assist.
resolution: Reset the user's Okta MFA token and synchronized the AD account attributes.

title: Intermittent connectivity to remote SQL instance
description: Clients lose connection to the production database randomly. Logs show connection reset errors, but ping remains stable.
resolution: Replaced faulty switch port causing packet drops during high-throughput database synchronization.

title: Application freezes during startup
description: The proprietary inventory software hangs at the splash screen every time. It uses a local SQL Express database. I need this to process warehouse shipments.
resolution: Increased the memory allocation for the SQL Express instance in the configuration.xml file.

title: Suspicious phishing email reporting
description: Hey team, just a heads-up that I got a phishy email from an external address posing as HR asking for payroll info. It’s got a sketchy link to a non-company domain, so I haven't clicked anything—just wanted to flag it for you guys to check out.
resolution: Verified the email as a phishing attempt, blocked the sender domain on the mail gateway, and purged the message from the user's inbox.

title: Database restore failed
description: Tried to restore a .bak file to the UAT environment, but it keeps erroring out with 'Operating system error 32 (The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process)'. Running Windows Server 2022. Please assist as this is blocking our QA cycle.
resolution: Identified that an automated backup script was locking the target directory; killed the background process and successfully performed the restore.

title: Slow query performance on Reporting DB
description: The 'GetMonthlyRevenue' stored procedure is taking over 45 seconds to execute. It used to run in under 2 seconds. The server environment is SQL Server 2019, and we haven't changed the query recently. This is very frustrating as it blocks our dashboard updates.
resolution: Performed index fragmentation analysis and found the primary clustered index was 98% fragmented. Rebuilt the index, reducing query execution time to 1.2 seconds.

title: SAN storage array failing
description: Alert: SAN-ARRAY-01 reporting critical hardware failure on Disk Shelf 3. Multiple drive indicators are flashing amber, and the management console is throwing Error 0x8004210B. We are currently in a degraded RAID state and need immediate assistance.
resolution: Coordinated with vendor hardware support to hot-swap two failed SATA drives and initiated a background rebuild of the parity stripe.

title: MFA device lost
description: I’ve managed to lose my phone, which—of course—had the Microsoft Authenticator app on it. Now I’m completely locked out of my email and can’t get any work done. How am I supposed to regain access to my account when the security setup is preventing me from logging in? I need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Verified user identity via manager, reset the MFA requirement for the account, and assisted the user in setting up a new device.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: I need help with the Q: drive. Every time I try to save a document, it gives me an access denied error. It was working fine yesterday, I swear.
resolution: Updated group policy permissions for the user; they were accidentally removed from the departmental security group.

title: Deadlock detected in checkout service
description: We are getting frequent deadlock errors in the checkout microservice using SQL Server 2019. The error message is 'Transaction (Process ID 82) was deadlocked on lock resources with another process'. It seems like the inventory update and payment status update are clashing.
resolution: Updated transaction isolation levels and reordered the sequence of DML operations in the stored procedure to prevent cyclic dependencies.

title: Just checking in on the infrastructure
description: I'm sure it's nothing, but the database cluster has stopped replicating and data integrity is currently failing across all shards. Please let me know if you need any tea or coffee while you handle this.
resolution: Rebuilt replication stream and verified checksums for all shards.

title: MFA push notification fatigue
description: I keep getting Duo push notifications on my iPhone 14 when I'm not even trying to log in. I've received five in the last ten minutes and it's starting to freak me out. What do I do?
resolution: Terminated all active sessions for the user and forced a global password reset. Investigation confirmed an ongoing credential stuffing attack targeting the account.

title: Suspicious background process
description: I noticed an unknown process called 'wscript.exe' running in Task Manager while idle on my workstation. It’s consuming high CPU and I'm worried it might be a script-based malware infection. Should I be concerned?
resolution: Ran a full EDR scan which identified a non-malicious administrative login script running. Terminated the process and optimized the script path.

title: Permission issue
description: I need read access to the marketing database ASAP. My manager already approved this request, but I still can't connect with my credentials. I keep getting an 'Access denied for user' error and I'm tired of wasting time on this. Fix it.
resolution: Granted SELECT permissions on the 'marketing_prod' schema to the user's AD group.

title: Database connection denied
description: The service account 'svc_app_db' is getting 'ORA-01017: invalid username/password' when trying to connect to the Oracle 19c database. We verified the vault password and it matches, but the DB seems to reject it.
resolution: The password in the DB wallet was out of sync with the Vault. Updated the wallet credential store.

title: Ethernet port dead
description: I am completely unable to get a network connection in room 204. I’ve wasted enough time troubleshooting this myself by testing multiple cables and even a different laptop, but the wall jack is clearly dead. This is preventing me from getting any work done, so please fix this immediately.
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a disconnected patch cable in the server room; re-patched and tested for signal.

title: VMware Host unresponsive
description: ESXi Host-08 has stopped responding to vCenter. The local console shows a Purple Screen of Death (PSOD) with an 'LINT1/NMI (motherboard-related)' error. It needs a hard reboot.
resolution: Power-cycled the physical host via iDRAC; triggered a firmware update for the PERC H730 RAID controller to prevent reoccurrence.

title: UPS Battery Fault - Site B
description: The APC Smart-UPS 3000 in the server closet is reporting a critical 'Replace Battery' alert on the LCD panel. SNMP traps are flooding the monitoring dashboard with 'Battery Low' events. This unit powers the primary domain controller and local file server.
resolution: Dispatched field technician to replace the RBC43 battery cartridge; self-test passed successfully.

title: Disk space full on File Server
description: Hey, the E: drive on FS01 is at 98% capacity. We are getting event ID 2013 alerts constantly. Can we increase the LUN size or do I need to clear logs?
resolution: Expanded the underlying LUN by 500GB via the SAN console and extended the volume in Disk Management.

title: File corruption reported on legacy share
description: Users are reporting that some files contain gibberish when opened. Engineers are debating whether this is a network transmission error or failing storage sectors.
resolution: Replaced failing hard disks in the RAID 6 array that were causing silent data corruption.

title: Frequent authentication failures on web portal
description: Users are randomly logged out or prompted for credentials multiple times. Could be a session cookie issue or an intermittent authentication server connectivity issue.
resolution: Synchronized time across domain controllers to fix Kerberos token validation failures.

title: Cannot access internal intranet
description: I am working remotely and I can't get to the company intranet portal. Every time I click the link, it just sits there and times out. My internet works fine otherwise.
resolution: Resolved DNS split-brain configuration issue on the internal VPN DNS server.

title: SAN latency spike on ESXi host
description: I'm seeing severe disk latency on host ESX-04. The VM kernel logs are reporting 'Device naa.6000eb38541234567890 latency has exceeded 500ms'. This is causing all VMs on the datastore to hang intermittently.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured backup snapshot task running during peak hours; throttled the I/O operations and latency returned to normal levels.

title: Strange pop-ups
description: Hey, I've got some weird ads popping up on my desktop. I didn't click on anything, but my Chrome tabs keep redirecting to suspicious sites. Please help, this looks like a virus.
resolution: Ran Malwarebytes scan, removed malicious browser extension, and cleared cached temporary internet files.

title: Core Switch Uplink Failure
description: The primary 10Gbps uplink on SW-CORE-01 dropped at 03:14 AM. Log files indicate a 'SFP+ Transceiver Signal Loss' error. Redundancy kicked in, but latency has spiked across the VLANs.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ module and patched fiber cable; confirmed link stability with zero packet loss.

title: SSL Certificate expiration
description: Our website is showing a security warning to all clients. The certificate expired yesterday. We need to renew this immediately.
resolution: Renewed the wildcard certificate via our CA and updated the binding on the IIS web server.

title: Zoom audio output issue
description: My Zoom client is not picking up my headset. It sees the device, but there is no sound output during meetings. I have checked the device settings within Zoom and Windows. This is extremely frustrating during client calls.
resolution: Updated the audio drivers for the docking station and set the headset as the primary communication device in Windows Sound settings.

title: Suspected phishing link clicked
description: I think I clicked a malicious link in an email from 'HR'. It redirected me to a suspicious URL and asked for my Office 365 login. I closed the tab immediately, but I'm worried about my account security.
resolution: Reset user password, revoked all active O365 sessions, and verified MFA registration. Scanned device with EDR; no malicious processes found.

title: Account locked again!
description: This is the third time this week! My account keeps getting locked for no reason while I'm in the middle of a client meeting. Please fix this permanently because it's killing my productivity.
resolution: Identified an old iPad still trying to sync email with an expired password; removed the device from the ActiveSync list.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: My drive M: keeps saying 'Access Denied'. This is very frustrating as I have a deadline. I am running Windows 10 build 22H2.
resolution: Found a stale AD group membership; removed and re-added the user to the appropriate Security Group.

title: Error 403 on Production Database
description: I am receiving a 403 Forbidden error when attempting to query the production SQL database via SSMS. I checked my permissions yesterday and they were fine, but now I can't even list the tables. I am working on the Q3 report and this is blocking my progress.
resolution: Re-applied missing permissions after a security group migration error.

title: Account lockout loop
description: My domain account is getting locked out every 15 minutes. I've restarted my desktop and cleared saved credentials in Windows Credential Manager, but it keeps happening. I can't get any work done.
resolution: Identified a stale service account credential on a disconnected peripheral device attempting to authenticate with an expired password.

title: Password reset for legacy system
description: Hey, can someone reset the password for the old inventory system? It’s not connected to our main SSO. Thanks a bunch.
resolution: Reset the password in the legacy SQL database and provided the temporary credentials to the user via encrypted email.

title: DNS resolution failing
description: I can ping 8.8.8.8 but I can't reach any websites by name. I flushed the local cache, but it's still not working. Seems like our DNS servers are down.
resolution: Resolved DNS forwarder configuration error caused by a recent ISP upstream server change.

title: Unauthorized software install
description: Endpoint protection alerted that a user on the marketing team installed unauthorized screen recording software. It bypassed UAC. Please check if this is a security risk.
resolution: Uninstalled the software and pushed a GPO to restrict executable installation paths.

title: Service account locked
description: Our automated deployment script is failing with error 403: Forbidden. It looks like the service account 'svc_deploy_prod' is locked out due to too many failed attempts on our staging server.
resolution: Unlocked the account in Active Directory and identified a stale credential on the staging build agent.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691
description: I am beyond frustrated. I am trying to connect to the corporate VPN using Cisco AnyConnect v4.10 from home, and it keeps throwing Error 691, claiming my username and password aren't recognized. I have already confirmed my credentials work perfectly fine when I log into the web portal, so clearly the issue is on your end. My account must be locked on the RADIUS server or something, so please just fix it already.
resolution: Reset user's Active Directory account password and cleared stuck VPN session on the ASA firewall.

title: Need access to production
description: Hey, I need read-only access to the production Postgres database for some audit reports. My username is j.doe. Thanks!
resolution: Granted the 'reporting_role' to user j.doe and confirmed they can access the required views.

title: Adobe Acrobat crashes on startup
description: Adobe Acrobat Pro DC crashes immediately upon opening a PDF file. The Event Viewer shows a Faulting module name: Acrobat.dll, version: 23.8.20470.0. I am running Windows 11 Pro 22H2 and have already tried a full reinstallation of the Creative Cloud suite.
resolution: Performed a clean registry scrub using the Adobe Removal Tool and reinstalled the application using the enterprise MSI installer.

title: Application timeout during peak hours
description: Users are reporting 504 Gateway Timeout errors when attempting to save records in the CRM during mid-morning. It is unclear if the SQL query is hanging or if the load balancer is dropping packets.
resolution: Optimized long-running query and verified bandwidth saturation on the application server NIC.

title: Access to Jira board for new hire
description: Please add user 'abrown' to the DevOps Jira project with admin rights. They joined the team today and need to configure the sprint boards.
resolution: Added user to the Jira 'DevOps_Admins' project role.

title: Routine request for an extra power strip
description: Hello, I hope you are having a wonderful Tuesday! Would it be possible to get an extra power strip for my desk? No rush at all, whenever you can get to it is fine.
resolution: Provided power strip immediately due to workstation shutdown affecting core production logging.

title: Ethernet port not working at desk
description: I moved my desk today and the wall jack doesn't seem to be active. I've tried three different CAT6 cables, but my workstation still shows 'Unidentified Network'.
resolution: Patched the wall jack into the correct VLAN in the MDF closet.

title: Database connection error (Access Denied)
description: We are getting 'Access Denied for user 'app_service'@'10.x.x.x'' when trying to connect to the MySQL staging database. This started happening right after the maintenance window last night. Please check the DB security groups.
resolution: Updated the RDS security group inbound rules to include the updated VPC IP range for the application server.

title: Server room cooling alarm
description: The HVAC sensor in the server closet is reading 88 degrees Fahrenheit. I don't hear the blower running. Please fix this before my servers melt.
resolution: Dispatched facilities team to reset the tripped breaker on the dedicated cooling unit; temperature returned to 68 degrees within 30 minutes.

title: High latency on database cluster link
description: We are observing packet loss between DB-NODE-01 and DB-NODE-02. Latency spiked to 400ms during the last backup window. Logs indicate potential buffer overflows on the aggregation layer.
resolution: Applied QoS traffic shaping policies to prioritize database sync traffic over management traffic.

title: Slight inconvenience with query speed
description: The main transactional database is currently deadlocked and returning 500 errors for all users. If you get a chance to peek at this, that would be grand, but don't stress about it.
resolution: Terminated orphaned long-running transactions and optimized indexes on the orders table.

title: Issue with Outlook search
description: Search in Outlook 365 isn't finding any emails sent after Tuesday. It's just spinning forever. Can someone take a look?
resolution: Rebuilt the Windows Search Index for Outlook data files.

title: ERP System throwing database connection errors
description: The SAP GUI keeps disconnecting randomly with error 'NIERRO_CONN_BROKEN'. It happens mostly when I run large report exports on my MacBook Pro M2. My network connection is stable, so I suspect it might be a timeout setting in the application.
resolution: Increased the KeepAlive timeout settings in the SAP GUI configuration file to handle long-running database queries.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud installation failure
description: I'm trying to install Photoshop on my MacBook Pro M2 running macOS Sonoma 14.2, but the installer crashes at 42% with error code 191. I have already cleared the OOBE folder cache and tried restarting the machine twice, but the issue persists. Please advise.
resolution: Resolved by running the Adobe Creative Cloud Cleaner Tool to remove corrupted registry artifacts and reinstalling the app from the enterprise portal.

title: Cannot access internal VPN
description: The VPN client (Cisco AnyConnect) refuses to connect. It says 'Posture assessment failed'. I recently updated my Windows 11 machine and I think that might be the cause.
resolution: Identified outdated antivirus definitions post-Windows update. Triggered manual update of security signatures, allowing the VPN client to pass the posture check.

title: Database corruption on legacy MySQL instance
description: The service failed to start after an unexpected power loss on our local dev machine running MySQL 5.7. Logs show 'InnoDB: Attempted to read 16384 bytes at offset...'. We have tried restarting but it immediately enters a crash-recovery loop.
resolution: Performed a hard recovery using innodb_force_recovery = 4 and exported data to a clean instance.

title: Elevated privileges required for software install
description: I need to install Python 3.12 for a dev project, but my standard user account is restricted. Please grant temporary admin rights to my machine (Asset ID: LAP-9982) so I can finish this by EOD.
resolution: Denied request for permanent admin rights; instead, deployed Python 3.12 via Intune to the user's machine.

title: Guest Wi-Fi signal is dead in the lobby
description: The 'Guest_Network' SSID is not appearing at all in the lobby area. I've checked the APs, and they seem to have power, but none of the visitors can connect. Please look into this ASAP.
resolution: Reset the local PoE switch; APs broadcasted successfully after a power cycle.

title: Static IP mapping requested
description: Hey, could I grab a static IP for the new Linux production server (PROD-SRV-04)? It needs to live in the 10.10.50.0/24 subnet. Thanks!
resolution: Assigned static IP 10.10.50.45 and updated the DNS record and DHCP exclusion range accordingly.

title: Locked out of AWS console
description: My IAM credentials for the production environment are locked. I entered the wrong MFA token three times in a row. My username is j.doe_admin.
resolution: Verified identity via manager approval and reset the MFA device for the user account.

title: HELP HELP HELP MY COMPUTER IS EXPLODING
description: My screen just went black for a second while I was checking my personal email. I think hackers have installed a keylogger! Please prioritize this above all else!
resolution: Re-seated the monitor power cable.

title: UPS Battery Fault - Rack B
description: The APC Smart-UPS in Rack B is emitting a continuous audible alarm. Management console displays 'Replace Battery' status with Error Code E-04. Input voltage is currently 120V, but the unit is failing to hold a load during self-tests.
resolution: Dispatched field technician to swap the lead-acid battery cartridge; unit passed self-test.

title: Zoom audio sync lag
description: The audio is consistently desynced from the video during all-hands meetings. My network latency is fine, but the Zoom desktop client CPU usage spikes to 90% during calls.
resolution: Updated Zoom client to the latest version and adjusted audio device buffer settings in the application.

title: Disk space alert for DB-Replica-02
description: Nagios triggered a critical alert for disk space usage on DB-Replica-02. The data drive is currently at 98%. This server handles our read-only reporting traffic.
resolution: Purged legacy transaction log files and moved older historical logs to an S3 cold storage bucket to free up 200GB.

title: Printer offline despite wired connection
description: The Xerox WorkCentre in the HR department shows as offline on all PCs. Static IP 192.168.1.50 is assigned, but it's not responding to pings from the server. Please check the network patch panel.
resolution: Replaced a faulty Cat6 patch cable and verified the link light on the wall jack was stable.

title: Routine notification
description: The primary domain controller is currently being encrypted by ransomware. Please acknowledge this ticket so it can be routed to the appropriate team.
resolution: Restored domain controller from offline backups and deployed updated antivirus definitions.

title: Switch port 12 down
description: I am formally reporting a persistent service disruption affecting the lobby wireless access point. Port 12 on the switch stack located in IDF-02 has entered an err-disabled state, resulting in a total loss of uplink connectivity. Please initiate a formal investigation into this failure and restore network access as a matter of priority.
resolution: Identified a flapping issue caused by a faulty patch cable; replaced the Cat6 cable and re-enabled the interface.

title: Network latency spike
description: We are currently encountering persistent packet loss affecting our VoIP telephony services, which has resulted in frequent reports of audio clipping by end users. A technical investigation into the relevant system logs is currently underway to determine the root cause of this performance degradation.
resolution: Reconfigured QoS tags on the core switch to prioritize VoIP traffic over general web browsing.

title: Redis connection leak
description: Our application is hitting the connection limit on the Redis cluster. It looks like the connections aren't being closed properly after the API calls finish. This is causing random 500 errors across our microservices.
resolution: Updated the application's connection pool settings and fixed a bug in the middleware where the Redis client was not properly disposed.

title: External drive encryption required
description: IT policy states that I need to encrypt my external backup drive before I can use it with my workstation. Can you point me to the right tool or guide to do this on Windows 11?
resolution: Provided instructions for using BitLocker To Go and verified the drive was encrypted to company standards.

title: Salesforce page unresponsive
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent technical failure regarding the Salesforce platform. The application consistently freezes during the generation of quarterly reports, rendering the feature unusable. An inspection of the browser console confirms a "Script timeout" error originating at line 442. This issue is reproducible and is currently affecting operations on Chrome version 122.0 running on macOS Sonoma. Please address this performance deficiency as a matter of priority.
resolution: Identified a malformed custom report filter; updated the filter logic and cleared browser cache.

title: Password reset keeps failing
description: Hey, I’ve tried using the self-service portal to reset my domain password three times now, but I keep getting an "Error updating password: Policy violation" message. I’m just trying to set it to my name and a number—any idea what's going on?
resolution: Educated user on password complexity requirements; reset password manually as a one-time courtesy.

title: Office printer offline
description: Hey, the big 3rd-floor Xerox is acting up and showing a "Network Error" again. I already tried restarting it, but it's still offline. Could someone take a look?
resolution: Corrected an IP address conflict; assigned a static reservation in the DHCP scope to prevent the printer from grabbing an existing address.

title: LUN mapping issue on ESXi host
description: We are unable to mount our iSCSI LUN from the Nimble storage array to ESXi host host-03. Error code: 'Host connection lost' shows up in vCenter. We have checked the switch fabric and physical links seem to be up.
resolution: Corrected an incorrect ACL entry on the storage array that was blocking the specific IQN of host-03.

title: VPN connection drops after 5 minutes
description: I'm working remotely on Windows 11 and my Cisco AnyConnect VPN keeps disconnecting. It usually happens right when I try to mount a network drive. The error code is 0x4000000A. Please help, I can't finish my report.
resolution: Updated the AnyConnect client to version 4.10 and cleared the local DNS cache using ipconfig /flushdns.

title: Critical: Database connection error in Production
description: The web application is throwing 'ORA-12516: TNS:listener could not find available handler with matching protocol stack' errors for all users. This is impacting all regional offices. Please investigate immediately.
resolution: Detected maxed-out connections on the Oracle DB instance; increased the PROCESSES parameter and killed idle zombie sessions.

title: Network slow, help?
description: Hey, is the internet acting up for anyone else? Everything's running super slow and I can’t seem to load any files from the server. Anything going on?
resolution: Investigated bandwidth utilization and discovered a large unauthorized backup process running on a workstation; throttled the process and optimized local QoS settings.

title: Duplicate records in production
description: Hey, looks like we’ve got thousands of duplicate entries in the audit_logs table—seems like the batch job is running twice. Can we get that cleaned up?
resolution: Used a Common Table Expression (CTE) to identify and delete duplicate rows while retaining the earliest record.

title: Performance degradation after migration
description: Ever since you forced this migration from SQL Server 2016 to 2022, the report generation service has become completely unusable. We’re constantly hitting timeouts on the report_gen_sp procedure, and it’s unacceptable that everything was working perfectly fine just yesterday before this upgrade. Fix this now.
resolution: Updated statistics on the affected tables and forced a plan recompile for the stored procedure to utilize the new Cardinality Estimator.

title: Unable to connect to production PostgreSQL cluster
description: Users are reporting 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections'. We seem to have hit the max_connections limit on the primary node. We are running Postgres 14 on RHEL 8.
resolution: Increased the max_connections parameter in postgresql.conf and implemented a connection pooler via PgBouncer to manage client requests more efficiently.

title: Browser shows 'DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN'
description: I cannot reach our main domain. It worked fine yesterday but today I just get this error. It's happening on my work laptop.
resolution: Changed the primary DNS server settings on the local adapter to use the internal company DNS instead of ISP defaults.

title: VPN MFA failing to trigger
description: When I connect to the VPN using Windows 10, the Duo push notification never reaches my phone. I get an 'Authentication Timeout' error after a minute. I've restarted my laptop twice.
resolution: Synchronized the time offset between the authentication server and the domain controller.

title: ERP login failing
description: I can't log into the ERP. It says 'Invalid credentials' but I haven't changed my password. Help.
resolution: Synchronized user Active Directory account with the ERP database and forced a password reset.

title: Zoom crashes upon joining meeting
description: Hey, Zoom keeps closing immediately after I click 'Join Meeting'. I'm on a ThinkPad X1 Carbon running Windows 11. I updated the drivers and reinstalled the app, but still nothing.
resolution: Updated the Intel integrated graphics driver, which was causing a rendering conflict with the hardware acceleration feature in Zoom.

title: SSH key rejection on dev-box
description: I am getting 'Permission denied (publickey)' when trying to SSH into the dev box. My key is definitely in my ~/.ssh/authorized_keys file. I checked the permissions on the folder, they are set to 700.
resolution: Discovered the user's public key was corrupted. Generated a new key pair and uploaded the public key.

title: Oracle ORA-00257 error
description: The database server is rejecting all incoming transactions. The alert logs show ORA-00257: Archiver error. Connect as INTERNAL until freed. This happened on our legacy Oracle 11g server running on RHEL 6.
resolution: Cleared the archived redo log directory which had reached 100% capacity and triggered a manual backup.

title: SAN latency spikes on SQL cluster
description: We are seeing significant I/O wait times on the SQL-Cluster-01 nodes during nightly backups. The SAN logs show latency exceeding 500ms on the fiber channel ports for LUN 05. Can you investigate the storage array performance?
resolution: Balanced I/O load across physical controllers and rescheduled the backup window to avoid peak application traffic.

title: Data corruption in SQL backups
description: We are seeing 823/824 read errors in the SQL Server error logs during the daily backup window. This suggests potential corruption on the storage backend. Please investigate the SAN logs immediately.
resolution: Found bad blocks on the physical backplane; migrated the SQL data files to a new SAN aggregate and performed a full checksum validation.

title: Slow internet speeds
description: The internet is basically unusable for the entire accounting team today. Pages are taking an eternity to load and our cloud software keeps timing out constantly. Is someone throttling our connection or is there some ridiculous bandwidth cap active that nobody bothered to tell us about?
resolution: Identified a massive background OS update consuming 90% of the circuit bandwidth; implemented QoS policy to throttle Windows Update traffic.

title: Unable to login to Oracle DB
description: Hi, I'm trying to connect to the dev oracle instance but I keep getting ORA-01017: invalid username/password. I'm using the credentials provided in the onboarding wiki. Could you check if my account is locked?
resolution: Account was locked due to too many failed attempts from an old cached password in SQL Developer; reset the account and cleared local credentials.

title: Can't access printer
description: The printer in the North wing is saying 'Access Denied' when I try to print from my office PC. It was working fine yesterday.
resolution: Re-added the user to the printer's authorized security group on the Print Server.

title: SQL Server deadlock on nightly ETL process
description: We are seeing frequent deadlock errors (Error 1205) during our nightly ETL load on our Production SQL Server 2019 instance running on Windows Server 2019. It seems to be impacting the 'Sales_Fact' table when the index rebuild job overlaps with the data import. Can you please review the locking behavior and suggest a change to the transaction isolation levels?
resolution: Modified ETL script to implement snapshot isolation and adjusted the index maintenance schedule to avoid overlapping with ingestion.

title: User reporting missing files
description: I am formally requesting assistance regarding the accidental deletion of an entire directory of project files from the file server. Upon investigation, I was unable to recover the data via the local Recycle Bin. Could you please verify the availability of a Shadow Copy or an equivalent backup to facilitate the restoration of these files?
resolution: Restored the folder from the most recent Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) snapshot taken at 04:00 AM.

title: Salesforce login loop on Chrome
description: I am losing my mind because Salesforce is trapped in a non-stop redirect loop every single time I try to log in. I’ve already wasted my time clearing the cache and cookies on Chrome v120.0, but it’s still doing the exact same thing—just refreshing the login page over and over again. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Cleared corrupted browser cache files and updated Salesforce security certificates in the user's profile.

title: Azure AD Join failing on new laptop
description: I'm setting up a new MacBook Pro for a new hire and the Azure AD join keeps failing with error code 80180014. The device is properly enrolled in our MDM, but it won't pull the enterprise policies.
resolution: Fixed the Conditional Access policy blocking macOS device registration and re-enrolled the device in the MDM console.

title: Access to HR files
description: Could I please get access to the HR folder for the annual review documents? Thanks, Dave.
resolution: Provided temporary read-only access to the requested folder.

title: Cannot map network drive
description: My laptop won't connect to the department drive. It keeps telling me 'The specified network name is no longer available'. Windows 11, running latest updates.
resolution: Updated the credentials stored in Windows Credential Manager and cleared the stale DNS cache.

title: Unable to connect to Mongo Atlas
description: I keep getting 'connection refused' errors when trying to connect to our MongoDB cluster via Compass. I've double-checked my IP whitelist and it includes my home office IP. Running on macOS Monterey.
resolution: Found that the user's ISP had rotated their public IP address; updated the whitelist in the MongoDB Atlas dashboard.

title: Guest Wi-Fi is down
description: Visitors can't connect to the Guest network. They see the splash page but authentication fails every time. Please fix.
resolution: Restarted the WLC authentication service which had stopped responding; guest portal is now successfully issuing tokens.

title: Request for Admin Rights
description: I need local administrator rights on my machine to install some development tools for the new project. Can you please whitelist my user account for elevation on the local workstation?
resolution: Request denied per security policy. Provided user with a temporary containerized environment to test the software requirements.

title: Cannot map network drive
description: I'm trying to connect to the 'Accounting' share but I get an 'Access Denied' message. My permissions shouldn't have changed, I've been using this folder for months.
resolution: Found that the user's account was inadvertently moved out of the correct AD security group during the last sync; restored group membership.

title: Phishing email reported
description: I just received an email from 'IT Support' asking me to click a link to verify my password. The sender address looks like a spoofed domain. Deleting it now, but wanted to let you know.
resolution: Verified email header and purged the phishing campaign from all user inboxes across the tenant.

title: Application failure: Heavy slow performance
description: The custom ERP software is lagging significantly today. Every time I click a button, the cursor turns into a spinning wheel for at least 30 seconds. This is making it impossible to process customer orders on time.
resolution: Diagnosed a memory leak on the application server; performed a rolling restart of the IIS services and cleared the application pool cache.

title: Website blocked by firewall
description: I am completely unable to access the essential research portal I need for my project because the firewall is falsely flagging it as 'Malware/Phishing.' This site is clearly safe and I am being prevented from doing my actual work. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: Whitelisted the specific URL in the web filter policy after verifying the site's reputation and security certificate.

title: Excel 365 freezing with large datasets
description: Every time I try to run a VLOOKUP across 50k rows in Excel for Microsoft 365, the application stops responding and force-closes. I am on a Dell Latitude 5420 with 16GB of RAM. It's becoming impossible to finish my weekly reporting.
resolution: Disabled hardware graphics acceleration in Excel settings and increased the virtual memory paging file size on the workstation.

title: External drive not mounting
description: Hey, I plugged my 2TB Seagate external drive into my MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma) but it just isn't showing up in Finder. I've tried different USB-C cables and ports, but nothing happens. I really need the files on here for a meeting this afternoon.
resolution: Used Disk Utility to identify the partition map corruption and ran 'fsck_exfat' in Terminal to repair the file system structure.

title: Entire floor lost internet
description: The internet is down for everyone in the West Wing. It looks like the network closet might be having an issue, as the main switch has amber status lights.
resolution: Power cycled the core switch stack and updated the firmware to address a known memory leak issue that caused the service interruption.

title: Reported Phishing Email
description: Hey, I just got this weird email claiming to be from the IT department asking me to 'verify my credentials' at a bit.ly link. It looks fake so I didn't click anything, but I figured I should let you guys know.
resolution: Confirmed malicious phishing attempt. Added the sender domain and URL to the organizational blocklist and purged the email from the mail server.

title: VPN client fails to initialize
description: Cisco AnyConnect isn't starting after the latest company image update. It just sits at 'Initializing...' and eventually times out. I've tried rebooting twice already.
resolution: Re-registered the Cisco AnyConnect virtual adapter service via command prompt to resolve a driver conflict.

title: SaaS Application Login Loop
description: I am experiencing an infinite redirect loop when trying to access our Salesforce instance via Okta SSO. It happens on both Chrome (v124) and Edge. It seems like my session token isn't being parsed correctly by the IDP.
resolution: Cleared the browser cookies and cache, then performed a forced sync between Okta and the Salesforce integration app.

title: Slow file access speeds
description: Hey, is the SAN acting up? Opening simple PDF files from the shared drive takes like 30 seconds today. It's really slowing down my workflow.
resolution: Identified a misconfigured VLAN tag on the storage switch causing latency; corrected port settings and restored normal throughput.

title: Disk space alert on DB-Cluster-04
description: The /var/lib/mysql partition is at 98% capacity on node DB-Cluster-04. The monitoring system is firing alerts every 5 minutes. If this fills up, the entire cluster will go down.
resolution: Purged archived transaction logs older than 30 days and extended the LVM volume on the host server.

title: BitLocker recovery screen loop
description: My Latitude 5420 is completely bricked on the BitLocker recovery screen after your mandatory firmware update. I don’t have the 48-digit key, and I have a presentation in exactly 20 minutes. I need someone to fix this immediately so I can actually get into my machine.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Active Directory and assisted user in bypassing the boot loop to restore access.

title: Unable to reach external website
description: Hey, we're trying to get into the vendor portal at www.vendor-secure.com, but our firewall is blocking it. We're getting an "Access Denied: Category Restricted" error page—could you help us get that unblocked?
resolution: Added the vendor domain to the corporate firewall whitelist as an exception for the relevant department.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud installation failure
description: Hey, having some trouble installing Photoshop on my M2 MacBook Pro (running Sonoma 14.2). The installer keeps crashing at 42% with error code 191. I’ve already tried clearing the OOBE folder cache and restarted the machine twice, but it’s still hitting the same wall. Any ideas?
resolution: Resolved by running the Adobe Creative Cloud Cleaner Tool to remove corrupted registry artifacts and reinstalling the app from the enterprise portal.

title: Change theme color in Excel
description: THE WORLD IS ENDING! THE EXCEL TAB COLORS ARE BLUE AND I ABSOLUTELY REQUIRE THEM TO BE GREEN. THIS IS A TOTAL SYSTEM FAILURE. FIX IT NOW OR I CANNOT GUARANTEE I WILL REMAIN CALM!
resolution: Showed the user how to change sheet tab colors in the Excel format menu.

title: Minor formatting issue on security dashboard
description: The font size on the main firewall dashboard is slightly misaligned. It’s not urgent, but would be nice to have fixed when someone has a moment.
resolution: Corrected CSS stylesheet error that was causing a buffer overflow in the security monitoring tool.

title: Endpoint Protection alerting on Trojan
description: My computer is acting really slow and CrowdStrike just popped up a notification saying it blocked a threat called 'Trojan.Win32.Generic'. I'm not sure if it caught it or if I'm still infected. Please check my machine.
resolution: Quarantined the malicious process originating from a browser download. Performed a full scan and cleared browser cache/temporary files.

title: Access Denied on Project Folder
description: I keep getting an 'Access Denied' error when trying to save files to the Marketing folder. I used to have access yesterday, but now it says I don't have permission. Can you fix this?
resolution: User was inadvertently moved to a different Active Directory group; restored group membership and refreshed Kerberos tickets.

title: San Snapshot Failure
description: The nightly snapshot job for the SAN-BACKUP-02 unit failed again with error code 0x8004230F. Logs indicate an Unexpected Provider Error. This is the third time this week.
resolution: Updated the VSS hardware provider driver on the host; performed a successful test snapshot manually.

title: Server room on fire - check storage
description: I think there is a small fire in the server rack. Could someone kindly peek at the NAS when they are finished with their lunch? It's just a tiny issue.
resolution: Extinguished rack fire and replaced melted drive sleds. Data recovered from off-site disaster recovery backup.

title: SSD failure on dev laptop
description: My laptop keeps crashing with a BSOD error 'CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED'. I ran the Dell ePSA diagnostics and it failed the storage test with error code 2000-0142. I think the drive is toast.
resolution: Confirmed physical SSD failure; dispatched replacement NVMe drive and performed OS re-image from standard corporate WIM.

title: URGENT: Database corruption error
description: This communication serves as a formal report regarding a critical service interruption affecting the CRM production instance. The system has generated a "Database page corruption detected" error, resulting in a total inability to access or retrieve client records. Given the severe impact on business operations and the resulting disruption to the sales department, I request that this matter be treated with the highest priority and resolved immediately.
resolution: Restored the database from the last successful hourly snapshot and performed a checksum validation to ensure data integrity.

title: New hire missing folder permissions
description: User joined the company but cannot see folders they require. Could be an AD group membership delay or a security restriction preventing new accounts from accessing sensitive zones.
resolution: Update Active Directory group memberships and apply relevant security clearance tags.

title: Slack notifications not appearing
description: Hey, for some reason I'm not getting any desktop notifications for Slack. I checked my settings, and they are turned on. I'm on macOS Sonoma. It's annoying because I keep missing messages from my manager.
resolution: Reset Slack notification permissions in macOS System Settings and toggled the Focus mode interference.

title: Printer connectivity
description: The printing hardware is currently experiencing a total service failure, rendering it entirely inoperable and requiring immediate technical intervention.
resolution: Reconnected loose Ethernet cable at the wall jack.

title: Database backup failed
description: The nightly backup job for the 'Clients' database failed with 'Error: Permission Denied on /backups/data_dump.sql'. This is the third time this week it has happened.
resolution: Corrected the ownership and group permissions on the backup directory to ensure the DB service account has write access.

title: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops in Building B
description: Users in the West wing of Building B are complaining about Wi-Fi disconnecting every 20 minutes. AP logs show 'Deauthentication: Reason 4 (Disassociated due to inactivity)'.
resolution: Adjusted channel width and updated firmware on AP-B-WEST-04 to address known radio interference issues.

title: Compromised machine suspected
description: I am formally reporting a significant performance degradation on my workstation, characterized by persistent CPU utilization at 99% attributed to the svchost.exe process. Furthermore, I observed an unauthorized prompt indicating a remote connection attempt. Consequently, as a precautionary measure to preserve system integrity, I have disconnected the machine from the network and require an immediate security investigation.
resolution: Isolated machine from VLAN. Ran full scan with CrowdStrike Falcon; identified and quarantined a malicious trojan payload. Re-imaged device to ensure complete remediation.

title: MFA device change
description: I got a new work phone. Need help migrating my Microsoft Authenticator app so I can keep accessing the internal portal.
resolution: Verified identity via manager and reset the user's MFA registration settings in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

title: Wi-Fi is super slow today
description: Internet in the breakroom is crawling. I'm connected to the Guest_WiFi SSID but I can barely load a webpage. Please fix it.
resolution: Identified a rogue access point causing co-channel interference on channel 6. Power-cycled the AP and set it to a static non-overlapping frequency.

title: Intermittent Wi-Fi drops in Building 4
description: Users in the east wing of Building 4 are experiencing frequent Wi-Fi disconnects throughout the day. It seems to happen specifically when moving between APs near the breakroom. We are using Aruba 505 access points running firmware 8.10.0.0.
resolution: Updated AP firmware to 8.10.0.4 and adjusted the transmit power settings to prevent client stickiness.

title: Blocked website access
description: Hey, quick question—I’m getting an "Access Denied: Malicious Sites" error when trying to check some project docs. I know the site is safe, but it looks like the firewall is blocking me. Could you help me get through so I can finish this research?
resolution: Reviewed the site's reputation, whitelisted the URL in the Zscaler policy, and cleared the user's browser cache.

title: Can't access printer
description: Hey, the hallway printer is acting up again and showing a "Network Error" on the screen. Could someone take a look when you have a sec? Thanks!
resolution: Static IP address conflict found; assigned a new reserved IP to the printer via DHCP.

title: Can't access internal portal
description: I am trying to log into the HR portal but I get a 403 Forbidden error. This happens on both Chrome and Edge. Is there a network restriction?
resolution: Added user's IP range to the whitelist on the internal firewall and verified session cookie permissions.
